data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 2.9m.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 4.571m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 3.138m (an adverse movement), representing approximately a 68.7% increase versus opening gross claims outstanding, resulting in closing gross claims outstanding of GBP 12.683m at 31 December 2017. The report notes adverse prior year development of GBP 2.9m net of reinsurance but does not attribute the movement to any specific named events or lines of business.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 2.9m.

For the most recent years, where a high degree of volatility arises from projections, estimates may be based in part on output from rating and other models of business accepted and assessments of underwriting conditions.

The measurement of the provision for claims outstanding involves judgements and assumptions about the future that have the most significant effect on the amounts recognised in the financial statements.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities - Claims outstanding) prior-year column. Prior year development gross figure taken from Technical Provisions note line 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column = 3,138). The report also states a net prior year adverse development of GBP 2.9m; no breakdown by line of business or named events is provided. A small gross claims development table exists but only covers UW years 2016 and 2017 limiting triangle-based PYD calculations.
